name: XAUUSD_SESSION_RANGE_BREAKOUT
description: Session Range Breakout Scalper: trade close-beyond confirmation of the previous Asian session range (prev day 00:00-07:00 broker time, UTC+3) during London/NY sessions. Stop below range or 0.8x ATR (whichever gives more room). 2.5R target.
hypothesis: Price tends to continue in the breakout direction after closing beyond the prior Asian session range during active London/NY liquidity windows.
